title: 第十五章  周家良玉猿背蜂腰第十六章  蛮人奸细三大武馆
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 河西县，周府。
管家周成顺着青石道，在众多下人一声声的问好中，一路深入，来到府内的书房门口。
他伸手轻轻敲门，等待片刻，里面传出周老爷的声音：
“进来吧。”
周成这才推门而入。
周老爷正坐在桌案后，翻阅着周家各个店铺的账本。
“老爷，事情没办妥。”
周成恭敬躬身说道。
“那小子年少气盛，一听是下聘迎娶，就跟我嚷嚷着莫欺少年穷一类的气话。”
周老爷动作一滞，抬起头看向周成：
“这小子倒是有几分脾气，过些天也是征兵的时间，虽然他上战场十有八九也是条死路，但也保不准给他真杀出条血路来。”
周老爷的语气变得冷漠：
“找人给他解决了，免得夜长梦多。
记住，找不相识的人，不要暴露身份，让人必须连他的身体都砍成三截，别给我整些死而复生的玩意。”
他自然知道自己的行为多招人怨恨，因此他周富贵从来不在明面上做强抢的勾当。
但若是女人成了寡妇，他周老爷还愿意既往不咎，收入门下，这不也说明了他周老爷的大气。
周成躬身答应。
就在周成退出去时，正好迎面碰见一个锦衣青年，
“周成，我爹又让你去干什么？”
周成连忙恭敬招呼：
“少爷。老爷就在书房，他吩咐我去店铺办点事。”
周成对于这位少爷的尊敬是发自内心的，年方十八，却已在武道上有所成就，若不出意外的话，过几年，周府便是这位少爷主事。
周良玉长得剑眉星目，一副翩翩公子的模样。
他皱着眉，看向周成。
虽然周成表面并没有露出任何异样，但周良玉心里清楚，自家老父亲真不算是好东西，这周成也是一个狗腿子，跟自家父亲蛇鼠一窝。
若不是看在他对周家忠心耿耿的份上，周良玉早就想换了他了。
“周成，我周家虽然不算大家，但多少还是得顾及名声，有些事情不要太过。”
周良玉淡淡说道。
“是，周成晓得。”
周成连忙应下。
content_en:
Hexi County, Zhou Mansion.
Housekeeper Zhou Cheng followed the bluestone path and went all the way to the door of the study room in the mansion, amidst the greetings from many servants.
He stretched out his hand and knocked on the door gently. After waiting for a moment, Mr. Zhou's voice came from inside:
"Come in."
Only then did Zhou Cheng push open the door and enter.
Mr. Zhou is sitting behind the desk, flipping through the account books of various stores in the Zhou family.
"Master, the matter is not done."
Zhou Cheng bowed respectfully and said.
"That boy was young and energetic. When he heard that he was going to marry me, he yelled at me and told me not to bully young people into poverty."
Mr. Zhou hesitated, raised his head and looked at Zhou Cheng:
"This kid does have a bit of a temper. It's time to recruit soldiers in a few days. Although he will most likely die when he goes to the battlefield, there's no guarantee that he will be able to fight his way out."
Mr. Zhou’s tone became cold:
“Find someone to solve it for him, so that he won’t have long nights and dreams.
Remember, when you find someone you don't know, don't reveal your identity. You have to cut his body into three parts, and don't give me any tricks about resurrecting him from the dead. "
He naturally knew that his behavior would arouse resentment, so he, Zhou Fugui, never committed any robbery in the open.
But if a woman becomes a widow, Mr. Zhou is still willing to forget the blame and accept her as his disciple. Doesn't this also show the magnanimity of Mr. Zhou?
"Yes!"
Zhou Cheng bowed and agreed.
Just as Zhou Cheng was exiting, he happened to meet a young man in brocade clothes.
"Zhou Cheng, what did my father ask you to do again?"
Zhou Cheng quickly greeted him respectfully:
"Master. The master is in the study. He asked me to go to the shop to do some errands."
Zhou Cheng's respect for this young master comes from the bottom of his heart. He is only eighteen years old, but he has already made some achievements in martial arts. If nothing else happens, in a few years, this young master will be in charge of the Zhou family.
Zhou Liangyu has sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, and looks like a handsome young man.
He frowned and looked at Zhou Cheng.
Although Zhou Cheng didn't show anything strange on the surface, Zhou Liangyu knew in his heart that his old father was really not a good guy, and Zhou Cheng was also a bitch, living in the same nest as his father.
If it weren't for his loyalty to the Zhou family, Zhou Liangyu would have wanted to replace him.
"Zhou Cheng, although my Zhou family is not considered a big family, we still have to take our reputation into consideration and don't go too far with some things."
Zhou Liangyu said lightly.
"Yes, Zhou Cheng knows."
Zhou Cheng quickly agreed.
